llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says and does not install code or request system credentials. However, a real-estate advisor legitimately asks for sensitive personal and financial information (income, pre-approval documents, mortgage terms, property docs). Before sharing anything: 1) avoid giving direct account logins, passwords, or social-security numbers unless absolutely required and you trust the recipient; prefer redacted or summarized data where possible; 2) if the agent asks you to upload documents, confirm how and where they will be stored or transmitted; 3) do not provide unrelated credentials (cloud keys, tokens) — if the skill ever asks for those, treat that as a red flag; 4) prefer sharing numbers and summaries rather than original documents when possible; and 5) if you want a higher-assurance review (legal or financial), use a human professional for final decisions. If you can paste the full SKILL.md (untruncated) I can re-check for any hidden steps that might change this assessment.
